description: This file defines the TransactionRepository class, which provides asynchronous CRUD operations and aggregation methods for managing transaction data in a SQLite database within a Flutter application. It encapsulates database interactions, including insert, update, delete, query by ID, list with optional filters, sum calculations, and groupings by category.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing CRUD operations and aggregations for transaction data in SQLite.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new transaction into the database and returns the inserted model with the assigned ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction identified by its ID; returns true if successful.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a transaction by ID; returns true if a row was deleted.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction by ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists transactions filtered by optional date range and category, ordered by date descending.

methods.name: sumAmountInRange
methods.description: Calculates total amount within a date range for an optional category.

methods.name: sumByCategory
methods.description: Returns total amounts grouped by category within a date range.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all transaction records, useful for testing.
